draft.subject: Re: Getting the rest of your team into Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Owen,

Thanks for the note — glad the first project is landing well, and good to hear the next step is getting the rest of the team in. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time, which is usually easier for a whole team at once.

If it's helpful, I can walk you through getting the team added on a short call this week — happy to work around your schedule.

Best,
Nadia
